title: Episode 1
summary: The incoming officer, Benjamin Brice, is found dead on his first day in an apparent bike accident.
method: The killer changed the time on his clock at home to establish an alibi while he murdered the victim.
motive: The victim left a dying message - an inverted Maria, to name a famous stamp that he was killed over. The victim was asked to raid the evidence room to take the letter with this rare stamp but refused. There was a fear that if he went to work, he would report this planned theft.
notes: This is probably one of the saddest episodes because they wrote an entire story on this young officer who never even makes it to his first day of work.
